## Built 2026-10-26: card fix, both queued items done

Why: the first card check (scheduled task `gen893-card-check-1`, 2026-10-26) FAILED: of 8 real /vet-rule approval cards since 2026-10-19, 3 left out some or all file sizes, all on multi-file changes or a non-rules file (they said "all within limits"). Cause: sizes were counted by hand, and the size check printed a number only near or over a limit. Plan approved by Erez 2026-10-26 (bundled with GEN-926), reviewed to convergence (3 reviewers, 2 rounds).

**Part 1, the size checker** (`~/.claude/skills/config-health/config-health-scan.ps1`), installed 2026-10-26. This closes the first item of the 2026-10-20 section above (option (a), extend size-check):
- `-Action size-check` now also prints `sizeLines`: one `size:` line per applicable limit, near a limit or not, in the form `size: <file> <now> → <proposed> / <limit> <unit> (<kind>; <limit id>)`. With `-AsIfPath` naming an existing file, now is that file; a new file prints `new → ...`; a file with no limits prints `size: skipped (...)`.
- The house cap prints as `house` (the label Erez chose when GEN-886 was built), not `hard`.
- Existing findings, lines and counts for size-sweep, size-check and scan are unchanged: before/after run on the real home folder gave identical results apart from the new command-file entry (GEN-926).
- Vetted voluntarily through /vet-code (the script is not hook-gated): in-session code review (3 findings: 2 fixed, 1 no change needed), independent Opus review PASS, 44 of 44 fixture tests (`notes/gen893/size-lines-test.js`), real-file regression (`notes/gen893/real-regression.js`). Installed byte-identical; previous version kept at `notes/gen893/wc/rollback-config-health-scan.ps1`.
- Demonstrated that the lines follow the limits file: lowering one limit in a copy of `notes/anthropic-guidelines.json` changed the line and raised a breach with no code change (`notes/gen893/limit-change-demo.js`).

**Part 2, the wording** (through /vet-rule, 4 reviewers then a combined re-review, converged in 2 rounds; the one material finding, that a CLAUDE.md change could be measured on the changed lines only, was fixed). Installed 2026-10-26, all five byte-identical, five passes consumed. This closes the second item of the 2026-10-20 section:
- `suggest/SKILL.md` check 4b: save the whole proposed file (never a snippet) and measure it with the size checker (one-line command given); carry its `sizeLines` unchanged. The five wording gaps each have one reading: ends smaller than today; a crossing Erez explicitly approved is not a departure; a /vet-rule card always shows sizes; descriptions and refs are measured by the checker; project CLAUDE.md files and `hooks/refs` notes count though /vet-rule does not gate them. `house` (our own cap) is treated like `hard`.
- `vet-rule/SKILL.md` Step 3: run the checker on each target's whole proposed file (for a CLAUDE.md text-replace, the full live file with the replacement applied) and paste its `sizeLines` verbatim, every line for every target, plus one plain sentence per target; a summary alone is not a size line. Step 1 carries the same lines. Three explanatory sentences were removed (Step 3's closing parenthetical; two Step 7 rationale sentences repeated in Step 8 and Step 7 item 1).
- Cap lines in `vet-rule`, `vet-code` and `vet-ticket` point to the size checker instead of `wc -m -l` (which counts bytes on this PC). The `/check` Holistic lens mirrors 4b.
- Sizes: suggest 3,068 → 3,141 / 5,000 tokens; vet-rule 11,348 → 11,396 / 12,000 characters (house); vet-code 11,580 → 11,597 / 12,000; vet-ticket 10,023 → 10,040 / 12,000; check 3,268 → 3,273 / 5,000 tokens. The plan aimed at no growth; four files grew slightly, all within limits, shown to Erez on the approval card.

**Checked after install:** the 4b command ran as written from the PowerShell tool. A fresh agent given only the installed skills measured the whole CLAUDE.md, used the given command, pasted every line plus a sentence, rejected a bare "within limits", and redesigned rather than cross a house cap. Small gaps it noted (not fixed): where to save the draft file; what the card shows if the checker errors; no card layout; whether a one-paragraph insert counts as a single-line replacement.

**Remaining check (automatic):** scheduled task `gen893-card-check-2` (2026-11-09 10:00) reads real /vet-rule cards made after the install. Pass = at least 3 cards, at least 1 with several files or a non-rules file, every file showing checker lines: sets this ticket Done. Too few cards: `gen893-card-check-3` (11-16) and `gen893-card-check-4` (11-23) try again. Any miss: stays in Review and the agreed next step is a ticket for an automatic block that refuses a /vet-rule approval without checker lines. Each run emails Erez a plain summary.

Priority unchanged: Not-urgent, Gain ratio 1, High.

**Status:** Review until that check passes.
